title: Trusted fulfillment-slot capacity source domain and persistence
selectedSlice: A — trusted fulfillment-slot capacity source domain + persistence
evidence: No canonical FOOD model establishes produced/package quantity-on-hand.
FOOD-005A keeps SKU identity separate from inventory and stock.
Frozen inventory quantity-on-hand, production batch, reserved quantity and sold quantity remain deferred.
Business architecture independently requires service-area/time-slot checks and launch capacity bounded by delivery slots.
FOOD-005T/U already provide append-only revision-aware fulfillment-slot capacity storage.
Existing FOOD persistence establishes consecutive revisions, exact retry versus conflict distinction and fail-closed storage semantics.

domain.capacityUnits: nonnegative safe integer representing explicitly supplied operational order-slot capacity

authority: The domain validates explicit trusted caller input; it does not derive slot capacity.
The D1 repository persists only fulfillment-slot capacity source revisions.
No public route, request adapter or runtime activation is added.
A later private single-admin operation-gate/service slice must control who may invoke the mutation.
Persistence existence does not itself authenticate a caller.
deferred: FOOD-005L acceptance creation after committed reservation
